"Ctla4" # tregs ) dotplot_df <- get_metadata_from_so(so, metadata = "clusters_T", genes = genes, reduction = NULL) %>% pivot_longer(cols = 3:ncol(.), names_to = "gene", values_to = "expr") %>% mutate(clusters_T = factor(clusters_T, levels = rev(cluster_ID_name_ordered))) %>% mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = genes)) %>% group_by(gene) %>% mutate(scaled_expr = as.vector(scale(expr))) %>% group_by(clusters_T, gene) %>% summarise(mean_scaled_expr = mean(expr)) %>% mutate( color = palette_cluster[as.character(clusters_T)], name = glue::glue("{clusters_T}") ) %>% mutate(name = fct_reorder(name, as.integer(clusters_T))) dotplot_df %>% ggplot() + aes(gene, name) + geom_point(aes(size = mean_scaled_expr, color = mean_scaled_expr)) + labs(caption = "color and size are scaled mean expression; cell types not shown in any particular order here") + scale_color_viridis(limits = c(NA, 3) ,oob = scales::squish) + remove_spines() + theme(panel.background = element_rect(color =
